description:
## Background

The first Focused canvas shows the parent hierarchy, but Graph Mode also exists to explain blocking relationships. Blocking links may cross parent trees and may form cycles when combined with parent links. They therefore need a distinct projection and visual treatment that does not perturb the parent-driven layout.

Relationship data can also reference an Issue absent from the Current Workspace snapshot. Silently dropping that endpoint without explanation would make the partial graph look authoritative when its source data is incomplete.

Triage: ready-for-agent.

## What to build

Extend Focused Graph with direct blocker context, directed blocker links, a clear relationship legend, and one aggregate warning when relationship endpoints are missing.

## Technical Approach

- Expand each Focused seed by one step through its `blockedBy` IDs, adding direct blockers found in `allIssues`, including closed blockers.
- Derive blocker → blocked links exactly once from each blocked Issue's `blockedBy` list; do not also derive them from `blocks`.
- Once the visible card set is known, include parent and blocker links only when both endpoints are backed by Current Workspace Issues and are visible.
- Keep Dagre input limited to parent links. Draw blocker links over the computed parent layout without changing card positions.
- Give blocker links a distinct edge type, direction marker, accessible description, and visual style.
- Add a compact legend that distinguishes parent → child from blocker → blocked.
- Have the graph module report missing parent or blocker endpoints as structured anomalies.
- Collapse any number of missing endpoints into one canvas warning with an accurate count; do not generate a banner per edge.
- Preserve deterministic card and edge output regardless of input ordering.

## Considerations

- Focused expansion is deliberately one step: do not recursively add blocker chains, parent ancestors, or the parents of blockers.
- Parent and blocker relationship sets may combine into cycles. Because only parent links feed Dagre, blocker cycles must not destabilize layout.
- An Issue can be both a Current Work seed and relationship context; it still appears once.
- A relationship to an Issue outside `allIssues` never creates a placeholder card.
- Ready and Blocked sidebar membership remains Beadwork-authored and must not be inferred from these links.
- Do not add Show all or Issue Detail in this slice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Focused adds each seed's direct blockers found in `allIssues` exactly once.
- [ ] Every rendered blocker edge points blocker → blocked and is derived only from `blockedBy`.
- [ ] Parent and blocker edges have visibly distinct styling, direction, type, and legend entries.
- [ ] Blocker links and cycles do not change the parent-derived card layout.
- [ ] Cross-tree blocker links render without duplicating cards or edges.
- [ ] Missing relationship endpoints create no placeholder cards and produce one aggregate warning.
- [ ] Deterministic output is preserved for an unchanged snapshot.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass.

## Test Plan

- Pure fixtures for direct blockers, closed blockers, duplicate relationship declarations, cross-tree blockers, mixed cycles, and absent endpoints.
- Assert exact edge direction, type, deduplication, anomaly counts, and unchanged parent layout inputs.
- Component tests for relationship styling, legend semantics, and aggregate warning behavior.
- Preserve the Focused parent-hierarchy tests from the preceding slice.
- Run the canonical `mise run verify` gate.
title: See blocking relationships and incomplete-data warnings
